Definition: of Hebrew origin (H3141); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.
BiblicalUsage: Joram is the king of Judah in Matthew's genealogy, the son of Jehoshaphat. In Matthew 1:8 Josaphat begat Joram, and Joram begat Ozias, in the line that runs from Abraham to Christ through the kings.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Joram's place in the list is a warning and a comfort together: a king who married into Ahab's house and still could not break the line God was keeping.
RelatedPeople: Joram, Son of Jehoshaphat; King Jehoshaphat
